#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

constexpr int MOD = 1000000007;

int modular_add(int x, int y) {
    x += y;
    if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
    return x;
}

int modular_multiply(int x, int y) {
    return (int)((long long)x * y % MOD);
}

int modular_subtract(int x, int y) {
    x -= y;
    if (x < 0) x += MOD;
    return x;
}

int modular_pow(int base, int exp) {
    int result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = modular_multiply(result, base);
        base = modular_multiply(base, base);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int extract_lowest_bit(int x) {
    return x & -x;
}

int N;
int adjacency[10][10];
int transition_table[70010][128];
int state_id_counter = 0;
int probabilities[10][128];
int dp[10][70010];
map<bitset<128>, int> state_map;

int traverse_states(bitset<128> current_state) {
    if (state_map.find(current_state) != state_map.end())
        return state_map[current_state];
    
    int node_index = ++state_id_counter;
    state_map[current_state] = node_index;
    
    for (int action = 0; action < (1 << N); ++action) {
        bitset<128> future_state = current_state;
        for (int idx = 0; idx < (1 << N); ++idx) {
            if (!future_state[idx]) {
                int overlap = action & idx;
                bool covered = false;
                while (overlap) {
                    int single_bit = extract_lowest_bit(overlap);
                    if (current_state[idx ^ single_bit]) {
                        future_state[idx] = 1;
                        covered = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    overlap -= single_bit;
                }
                if (!covered) future_state[idx] = 0;
            }
        }
        transition_table[node_index][action] = traverse_states(future_state);
    }
    return node_index;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> N;
    traverse_states(1);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            cin >> adjacency[i][j];
            adjacency[i][j] = modular_multiply(adjacency[i][j], modular_pow(100, MOD - 2));
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
            probabilities[i][mask] = 1;
            for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                if ((mask >> k) & 1)
                    probabilities[i][mask] = modular_multiply(probabilities[i][mask], adjacency[i][k]);
                else
                    probabilities[i][mask] = modular_multiply(probabilities[i][mask], modular_subtract(1, adjacency[i][k]));
            }
        }
    }
    
    dp[0][1] = 1;
    for (int step = 1; step <= N; ++step) {
        for (int node = 1; node <= state_id_counter; ++node) {
            for (int choice = 0; choice < (1 << N); ++choice) {
                int next_node = transition_table[node][choice];
                dp[step][next_node] = modular_add(dp[step][next_node], modular_multiply(dp[step - 1][node], probabilities[step - 1][choice]));
            }
        }
    }
    
    bitset<128> full_mask;
    full_mask.flip();
    cout << dp[N][state_map[full_mask]] << "\n";
    
    return 0;

inline int mul_mod(int x, int y) { return (int)((1LL * x * y) % MOD); }
inline int sub_mod(int x, int y) { return (x -= y) < 0 ? x + MOD : x; }
inline int pow_mod(int b, int e) {
    int res = 1;
    for (; e; e >>= 1, b = mul_mod(b, b))

}
inline int get_bit(int x) { return x & -x; }

int n, A[10][10], trans[70010][128], node_count = 0, prob[10][128], DP[10][70010];

int build_state(bitset<128> S) {
    if (state_ids.count(S)) return state_ids[S];
    int u = ++node_count;

    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        bitset<128> ns = S;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
            if (!ns[i]) {
                int ov = mask & i;
                bool found = false;
                while (ov) {

                    ov -= lb;
                }
                if (!found) ns[i] = 0;
            }
        }
        trans[u][mask] = build_state(ns);
    }
    return u;

    printf("%d\n", DP[n][state_ids[full]]);
